project_name.justification: The article is titled "Tarku Acquires 100% of the MAX Lithium Property" and refers to the project as the "MAX Lithium property" throughout.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Tarku Resources Ltd (TSXV:TKU)(FRA:7TK)(OTCQB:TRKUF) (the "Company" or "Tarku")".

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO: "Julien Davy, P.Geo., M.Sc, MBA, President and Chief Executive Officer of Tarku..." and quotes him as "Julien Davy, President and CEO of Tarku Resources".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The headline states: "Tarku Acquires 100% of the MAX Lithium Property". The body confirms: "Tarku can earn a 100% interest in the MAX Lithium property...".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the "MAX Lithium property".

verified_article_link.justification: The article content directly corresponds to the acquisition of the Max project by Tarku Resources Ltd., as confirmed by the headline and body of the text.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Tarku Resources Ltd., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian stock exchange. The separate financing mentioned uses the '$' symbol, which is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD) in this context.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the section "Summary of the transaction to acquire the MAX Lithium property" only mention the issuance of common shares as consideration, with no mention of a cash payment.

share_payments_raw.justification: According to the data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because the consideration is specified by the number of shares to be issued (`amount_of_shares_issued`) and a price per share, not a total share value.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: No single combined cash and share value for the transaction is provided in the text.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The summary of the transaction states: "Tarku can earn a 100% interest in the MAX Lithium property by issuing 4 million common shares of the Company...".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the consideration for the property acquisition. The warrants mentioned are part of a separate financing transaction, not the acquisition itself.

option_payments_raw.justification: No stock options were mentioned as part of the consideration for the property acquisition. The options grant mentioned is a separate corporate action for directors, officers, and consultants.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.01'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text mentions a future exploration program but does not specify a drilling commitment in meters as part of the acquisition agreement.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: While the text states "We intend to do aggressive exploration", no specific monetary value for an exploration commitment is mentioned as a term of the acquisition.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or other royalty being acquired or retained as part of the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the acquisition is for "28 claims (19.25 km2) forming the MAX Lithium property".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text specifies the unit for the area: "...28 claims (19.25 km2) forming the MAX Lithium property".

resource_size.justification: The text does not state a mineral resource for the MAX project itself, noting it has "as-yet untested potential". The resource mentioned ("proven reserves of 1.2 million tonnes grading 0.92% Li2O and probable reserves 28 million tonnes grading 0.96% Li2O") is explicitly for the nearby "Sayona Mining's North American Lithium mine", not the MAX project.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The company is identified in the first paragraph as "Tarku Resources Ltd (TSXV:TKU)(FRA:7TK)(OTCQB:TRKUF)".
